basic_info.headline: Talent Acquisition Director
basic_info.about: I am a Senior Talent Acquisition Leader providing expertise in talent development and elevation,  candidate sourcing, relationship management, recruitment processes and procedures, behavioral interviewing and employment branding. I truly enjoy developing and building out processes and teams.  It requires going beyond work experience or skill sets and delving into intangibles like personality, outlook and the way we approach a challenge. When everything aligns, it presents the opportunity to do amazing things – both as a company, and in one’s career.

experience.title: Business Owner
experience.description: A small start-up online retail business designing and selling unique products. The majority focused on adoption, foster care, and neurodiversity awareness.

experience.title: Senior Manager, Global Talent Acquisition - Sleep & Respiratory Care
Senior Manager, Global Talent Acquisition - Operations & Corporate
experience.location: San Diego County, California, United States

experience.title: Talent Acquisition Manager
experience.description: Leading a remote team of 30+ recruiters responsible for high-volume recruitment within North America.  Managing recruitment planning and execution for major expansion projects for sites pivoting to support Covid-19 related products.  Develop and elevate the high-volume recruitment function beyond reactive support to proactive partnerships with the business.

experience.title: Senior Recruiter
experience.description:
As a Sr. Recruiter at Thermo Fisher Scientific, the talent I source has a direct impact on the success of our organization. Our mission is enabling our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. So I’m always looking for people who are passionate about what we do and ready to make a difference in people’s lives – across the globe.

EXPERIENCE
•	Provide behavioral interview training
•	Consult on employment branding initiatives
•	Identify and source candidates
•	Deliver full-cycle recruitment support
•	Create job ads and posting strategies
•	Work closely with Hiring Managers on planning, strategy, options and interviewing
•	Coach interviewing teams on interviewing skills and techniques
•	Manage recruitment resources and vendors

Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc. (NYSE: TMO) is the world leader in serving science, with revenues of $17 billion and 50,000 employees in 50 countries. Our mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We help our customers accelerate life sciences research, solve complex analytical challenges, improve patient diagnostics and increase laboratory productivity. 

Thermo Fisher Scientific’s ability to grow year after year is driven by our team’s ability to attract, develop and retain world-class people who will thrive in our environment and share in our desire to improve mankind by enabling our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. All of our employees share a common set of values - Integrity, Intensity, Innovation and Involvement. If you share those values and if you're looking for an employer who is strongly committed to developing talent and rewarding achievement, come grow with us at Thermo Fisher Scientific.
